positions.title: Marketing Manager at LEGO Education International
positions.description:
I'm proud to be part of the LEGO® Education team. For more than 37 years, LEGO® Education has been working with teachers and educational specialists to deliver playful learning experiences that bring subjects to life in the classroom and make learning fun and impactful. Our wide range of physical and digital educational resources encourage students to think creatively and be self-dependent, lifelong learners ready to shape their own future.
I enable our international markets and trade partners with content, PR and events expertise on our journey to support ever more teachers and young learners around the world.

company.name: Goethe-Institut e.V.
company.description:
The Goethe-Institut is the cultural institute of the Federal Republic of Germany with a global reach.

We promote knowledge of the German language abroad and foster international cultural cooperation. We convey a comprehensive image of Germany by providing information about cultural, social and political life in our nation. Our cultural and educational programmes encourage intercultural dialogue and enable cultural involvement. They strengthen the development of structures in civil society and foster worldwide mobility.

With our network of Goethe-Instituts, Goethe Centres, cultural societies, reading rooms and exam and language learning centres, we have been the first point of contact for many with Germany for over sixty years. Our long-lasting partnerships with leading institutions and individuals in  hundred countries create enduring trust in Germany. We are partners for all who actively engage with Germany and its culture, working independently and without political ties.
